messages:
Alex (CEO): Thanks for coming to today's town hall. Quick thread for the follow-ups people asked for during Q&A. I'll drop links and owners here. React with :thumbsup: if you saw this.

notifier-bot: Recording + deck: https://zoom.redwood/rec/def456 | https://drive.redwood.com/all-hands/mar-2026/deck.pdf

Noelle (Product): One question from customers: will the new routing policies support per-tenant overrides at GA?

Maya (CTO): Short version: yes, per-tenant routing controls are planned for GA but will be limited in the beta. Beta will support tag-based routing and a simple override flag; finer-grained policies later. Noelle to publish the beta capability list.

Ravi (Engineering): For the demo benchmarks, folks asked for raw config. I'll share the exact docker run + env we used and the synthetic load script.

Maya (CTO): Awesome. Please include kernel/quantization settings and any custom compile flags. Put it in the internal bench repo and paste the link here.

Ravi (Engineering): Will do. Example quick snippet I'll publish: ```bash
python tools/load_test.py --model redwood-7b --seq 1024 --concurrency 4 --quant q4_0
```

Diego (Infra): Question from ops: when will APAC regions be available for Dedicated? Tentative: early Q4 but need procurement signoff. I'll coordinate with sales on expectations.

Helena (Security): A couple security questions in the Q&A about key management in Private. We have a short FAQ draft; I'll upload the FAQ and the KMS integration checklist. Owners: Helena + Diego.

Noelle (Product): Can someone prepare a crisp one-paragraph summary of the beta partner expectations (SLA, data policies, integration effort) for GTM? I'll assemble and share with growth.

Alex (CEO): Please make that short and customer-facing. Noelle to own.

Maya (CTO): Consolidated action list: 1) Beta feature list & tenant-routing note (Noelle) 2) Bench configs + run scripts (Ravi) 3) APAC Dedicated timing update (Diego) 4) Private KMS FAQ + checklist (Helena) 5) Beta partner summary for GTM (Noelle). Update here when done.

Ravi (Engineering): Pushed initial bench artifacts to https://git.redwood.com/bench/artifacts/mar-2026 and added the load script. I'll clean up docs by Wednesday.

Helena (Security): FAQ uploaded: https://confluence.redwood.com/security/private-kms-faq Draft checklist attached. Feedback welcome from infra and product.

Noelle (Product): Draft beta partner one-pager: https://docs.google.com/draft/redwood-beta-partner-brief Will solicit feedback from sales and solutions.

Diego (Infra): Open ticket for APAC procurement: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INFRA-1423 I'll update ETA when procurement confirms.

Alex (CEO): Great work. If any blockers pop up, escalate to me or Maya. Closing the thread in 48h unless there are outstanding items.

notifier-bot: Follow-up checklist created: https://tasks.redwood.com/board/all-hands-followups-2026-03-23
